author: Out Loud Chorus
title: Seeking Freelance Graphic Designer for January 2027 Concert
content:
If only our graphic design were as strong as our singing. Clearly, we need you.

We are seeking a freelance graphic designer for our January 2027 concert. This remote contract project includes concert posters and postcards, email headers, and a seasonal winter postcard.

Have a strong portfolio, an eye for typography, and experience designing for print and digital? We would love to see your work. Most concert materials will be needed in November 2026.

Email your cover letter, portfolio or work samples, estimated rates, availability, and turnaround time to outloudchorus@gmail.com by October 19, 2026 for priority consideration.

Know a designer who would be a great fit? Share this post and tag them!

Job posting: https://olconline.org/job-openings

author: Trabahero.PH
title: Turing Hiring Illustrators, Sketchers & Cartoonists for AI Project
content:
**WE'RE HIRING! ILLUSTRATORS, SKETCHERS & CARTOONISTS!**

**TRABAHERO PH | Your Next Opportunity Starts Here!**

Are you passionate about digital art, character design, or creative illustration?

**Turing is looking for talented artists to contribute to an exciting AI project!** Interns, fresh graduates, emerging artists, and experienced professionals are welcome!

**JOB DETAILS**

Company: Turing

Position: Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Location: Fully Remote

Compensation: Paid in USD (per approved task; rate not specified)

Project Duration: 10–12 weeks

Commitment: 20–40 hours/week

Start: After onboarding and portfolio approval

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop

Digital Illustration & Sketching

Character Design & Cartooning

Composition, Color & Perspective

Creativity & Attention to Detail

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Strong art portfolio showcasing your skills

Experience with Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools

Ability to maintain character consistency across different styles

Familiarity with surreal, cinematic, retro, steampunk, or other visual styles is a plus

Able to work independently and meet deadlines

**YOUR ROLE**

Create high-quality character illustrations from references.

Develop creative variations while preserving character identity.

Adapt artwork to different artistic styles.

Refine designs based on project feedback.

Document creative choices and submit polished artwork.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**trabaheroph@gmail.com**

**Subject:** Illustrator/Sketcher/Cartoonist

Attach your updated CV and **art portfolio** (Behance, ArtStation, Google Drive, or personal website).

Shortlisted applicants will undergo portfolio review before onboarding.

title: Turing Calling All Artists for Frontier AI Project
content:
**Calling all artists: get paid to create art for a frontier AI project!**

Turing, one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, is looking for **Illustrators, Sketchers, Cartoonists, Digital Artists, and Concept Artists** to join a remote project.

**What you’ll do:**

Create digital character illustrations and sketches from reference images

Produce creative variations while keeping the character’s identity consistent

Apply strong fundamentals: composition, color, lighting, perspective, and proportion

Work across styles like surreal, cinematic, vintage, retro, steampunk, and glitch art

Document your creative decisions and style choices

**What you’ll need:**

A strong portfolio showing creativity, versatility, and attention to detail

Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Affinity, or similar tools

The ability to work independently and meet timelines

**The details:**

Fully remote

Paid in USD

10-12 weeks, with flexible hours (up to 40/week, or part-time up to 20/week)

Starts after onboarding and portfolio approval

Whether you’re an intern, a fresh graduate, an emerging artist, or a seasoned pro, you’re welcome to apply. This is a great chance to build hands-on experience on a leading AI project while doing what you love.

**Apply here and submit your portfolio:** https://work.turing.com/r/Z8WK4lG5Jy
